prose: Anthropic and the medical knowledge platform OpenEvidence are partnering to bring AI-powered search to physicians in about 100 low- and middle-income countries, Reuters reports. The collaboration will offer a specialized version of OpenEvidence's AI search tool built for those markets.
highlights: Anthropic and OpenEvidence partner on medical AI search for physicians.
The offering targets about 100 low- and middle-income countries.
The product is a specialized version of OpenEvidence's AI search tool for doctors.
